sections.heading: Flagged items in detail
paragraphs: FCF Generation Consistency: Free cash flow was positive in 2 of the last 5 reported years. Repeated FCF deficits mean growth is being funded by the balance sheet rather than by the business.
Debt-to-Equity Trajectory: Leverage moved from 2.28x to 1.93x equity. Leverage is high enough to transmit an earnings shock directly into equity value.
Current Ratio Liquidity: Current assets cover current liabilities 0.95 times. Liquidity is tight relative to short-term obligations.
ROE vs. ROCE Quality: Return on capital employed of 11.0% with ROE of 13.0% is close to or below the cost of capital, so growth destroys rather than creates value.
CapEx Intensity Check: Capital expenditure averaged 25.0% of revenue. Capex intensity is unusual for the business model and needs a return check.
Earnings Volatility Check: Earnings per share fell in 1 of the last 4 years with a growth standard deviation of 44 points. Earnings are erratic, which argues for a wider margin of safety.
Interest Coverage Safety: Operating profit covers interest 2.5 times. Coverage is thin enough that a profit dip would pressure debt service.

Auditor & Governance Cleanliness: Aggregating the accounting evidence: 3 hard red flags and 4 watch items, with a LojikX™ Consistency Score of 57/100. The pattern of flags warrants a closer read of the auditor notes and related-party disclosures.
